patterns.name: Case Management
commonFeatures: Applicants submit an intake form.
Staff review the application for eligibility.
Staff may request more information.
The application moves through statuses such as submitted, under review, approved, rejected, or withdrawn.
Applicants may receive notifications when the status changes.

unsupported.reason: No ADSP service accepts or reconciles payments.
unsupported.suggestedApproach: Integrate a third-party payment gateway and record the outcome as a case note or value-service record.

unsupported.reason: No ADSP service verifies identity against an external registry or conducts background checks.
unsupported.suggestedApproach: Integrate the relevant external verification service and store the result as supporting evidence.

patterns.name: Grant Applications
commonFeatures: Applicants complete an application form with organization, project, and budget details.
Applicants attach supporting documents such as financial statements or letters of support.
Reviewers check eligibility and score applications against criteria.
Decision makers approve, reject, or conditionally approve funding.
Applicants are notified of decisions and may be asked for more information.
Funded recipients submit progress or final reports, and funds are monitored after approval.

unsupported.reason: No ADSP service issues or tracks fund transfers to recipients.
unsupported.suggestedApproach: Integrate with the government financial/payment system and record the disbursement reference in value-service.

patterns.name: Permit / licence application
commonFeatures: Applicants submit an application with supporting documents and fees.
Staff review and approve, refuse, or request changes.
An approved permit or licence is issued, often as a certificate or document.
Holders renew before expiry and may be reminded automatically.
Staff can suspend, revoke, or amend a permit or licence.
Applicants and the public can check the current status or validity.

patterns.name: Registration / enrollment
commonFeatures: A registrant submits a form with identifying and descriptive details.
Submissions are validated, and duplicates are detected.
The registrant receives a confirmation or registration number.
Registrants can update their details or deregister.
Staff can search and view the registry.
Some registrations require approval or periodic renewal.

unsupported.reason: No ADSP service accepts or reconciles payments.
unsupported.suggestedApproach: Integrate a third-party payment gateway and record the paid status as a registry field in value-service.

unsupported.requirement: Verification against an external authoritative registry
unsupported.reason: No ADSP service verifies status against an external registry, such as a corporate or professional licensing body.
unsupported.suggestedApproach: Integrate the external registry's API and surface the verification result to staff during review.

patterns.name: Inspection / compliance
commonFeatures: Inspections are scheduled or triggered by risk, complaint, or permit.
Inspectors record findings, often on a mobile device in the field, with photos.
Orders or corrective actions are issued with due dates.
Remediation is tracked and verified through follow-up inspections.
Inspection reports are generated and shared with the regulated party.
Compliance history is available for each site or entity.

patterns.name: Complaint / concern intake
commonFeatures: Public or internal users submit a complaint, optionally anonymously.
Complaints are triaged and categorized or prioritized.
Complaints are assigned to an investigator or team.
Investigators record notes, evidence, and outcomes.
The complainant is acknowledged and receives a response.
Complaints can be closed, escalated, or referred elsewhere.

patterns.name: Consultation / feedback collection
commonFeatures: A consultation or survey is opened for a period of time.
Participants submit responses through a form, sometimes with attachments.
Responses are collected, categorized, and analyzed for themes.
Targeted stakeholders may be invited and reminded.
Outcomes are summarized and published as a what-we-heard report.

patterns.name: Benefit / eligibility assessment
commonFeatures: Applicants answer questions that capture facts about their situation.
Rules are applied to determine eligibility, automatically or through staff review.
The applicant is told whether they qualify and why.
Decisions can be appealed or reassessed when circumstances change.
Eligibility rules are updated as policy changes.

patterns.name: Appointment / booking request
commonFeatures: Users see available times and request or book a slot.
Bookings are confirmed and calendar entries created.
Users can reschedule or cancel.
Reminders are sent before the appointment.
Staff manage availability and see their schedule.

unsupported.requirement: Advance payment at time of booking
unsupported.reason: No ADSP service accepts or reconciles payments.
unsupported.suggestedApproach: Integrate a third-party payment gateway and record the paid status against the calendar-service event.

unsupported.reason: No ADSP service creates or manages video-conferencing links.
unsupported.suggestedApproach: Integrate a meeting provider API and attach the generated link to the calendar event.

patterns.name: Document submission / package review
commonFeatures: Submitters upload a defined set of required documents.
Completeness is checked against a checklist.
Reviewers read the documents and add comments.
Changes or additional documents can be requested and resubmitted.
Versions of documents are retained.
The package is accepted or rejected, and the submitter is notified.

patterns.name: Incident / emergency response reporting
commonFeatures: A reporter submits incident details quickly, often with location and photos.
Incidents are classified by severity and routed to responders.
Responders and coordinators log actions and updates as events unfold.
Interested parties are alerted to new incidents and changes.
Incidents are closed with a summary and lessons learned.

patterns.name: Information request / FOIP-style request
commonFeatures: Requesters submit a request describing the records they want.
A coordinator logs the request and assigns an analyst.
Program areas are asked to search for and provide records.
Analysts review and redact records before release.
A response package is prepared and sent within the statutory deadline.
Fees and extensions are tracked.

patterns.name: Referral / routing workflow
commonFeatures: A request is submitted with details that determine where it belongs.
Routing rules choose the destination team, ministry, or program.
The destination is notified and accepts or redirects the referral.
The requester is told where their request went.
Routing outcomes are monitored for misroutes.

patterns.name: Status tracking portal
commonFeatures: Users sign in or enter a reference number to find their request.
The current status and a history of steps are shown in plain language.
Users see what is outstanding and what they must do next.
Users are notified when the status changes.
Staff updates drive the status shown.

patterns.name: Audit / evidence trail
commonFeatures: Significant actions are recorded with the actor, time, and context.
Decisions record the reason for the decision.
The trail cannot be altered by ordinary users.
Authorized users can search and filter the trail.
The trail can be exported for auditors or investigations.
Records are kept for a defined retention period.

patterns.name: Public reporting / data collection
commonFeatures: Reporting entities are told when a report is due.
Entities submit data through a form or upload, sometimes with validation.
Late or missing reports are followed up.
Submitted data is aggregated and analyzed.
Results may be published publicly.
Entities can correct and resubmit a report.

patterns.name: Template-driven document generation
commonFeatures: Templates define the layout and wording of documents.
Data from a form or record fills the template.
Documents are generated as PDFs and stored.
Generated documents may need review or approval before release.
Documents are delivered to the recipient or made available for download.
Templates are updated as policy or wording changes.

patterns.name: Notification campaign / subscription
commonFeatures: Users choose topics or categories to subscribe to and the channels to receive them on.
Staff publish announcements or alerts to subscribers.
Reminders are sent on a schedule or triggered by events.
Users can manage preferences and unsubscribe.
Delivery results are tracked.

patterns.name: Internal service request
commonFeatures: Staff submit a request using a form specific to the service.
Requests are routed to the right team and assigned to a person.
The requester can see progress and communicate with the fulfiller.
Requests are completed and closed, sometimes with approval steps.
Teams monitor volume and service-level performance.
